relationship_to_land.analysis: separate external-validity estimate; no pooling with land

planned_configurations.purpose: retained-model route restriction with physical-global qualification
transient response discrepancy followed by measured compensation
visible obstacle without proven Nav2 consumption
observed lateral disturbance without unique wind/current/wave attribution

selection_rule: Freeze exact starts, goals, conditions, questions, evidence masks, references, and order after development readiness without inspecting prospective P/R differences.

readiness_evidence.retained_nominal: three strict-valid known-path docks and three strict-valid far NavigateToPose docks under the current corrected configuration
readiness_evidence.retained_diagnosable: pre-correction terminal-margin failure and retained-grid disconnection development artifacts
missing: restoration test of the full canary artifact set

causal_limits: Observed lateral displacement is not by itself wave drift.
A lumped response residual does not uniquely identify current, wind, waves, collision, or actuator failure.
Visible geometry does not establish Nav2 delivery, consumption, or decision dependence.
Retained-grid disconnection establishes only a bounded navigation-model result, not global physical infeasibility.
